name: te5_dial_inlay
purpose: Inlaid Roman numerals, minute track and inner ring on the solid dark chapter ring (C3 inlay plane, 24.4 studs)
notes: C3 SurfaceGui Face=Back, image +y toward XII. r 1 = 12.2 studs. White 250 strokes, 2 px ink (10,10,14, 0.9). Radial numerals (tops outward, XII upright), IIII at 4 as on clock dials. Half-hour 4-point stars, tip radius 0.025.

name: te5_subdial
purpose: Engraved guilloche face of the 6.5-stud sub-dial at the clock centre (C6)
notes: C6 Face=Left. 24-circle rosette (alpha 0.85, no ink) kept off r < 0.15, which the hub stack covers anyway.

name: te5_accretion
purpose: Opaque swirling accretion disc around the void (V2, 13-stud plane, Top+Bottom GUIs)
notes: Streaks and the 3 dust lanes wind CLOCKWISE outward (image +y up): turn the image COUNTER-clockwise (as seen on the Top face) for trailing streaks -- verify the sign of 'dir' in the preview. Opaque BLACK inner skirt r 0.60-0.68 (inside / under the 8-stud core's silhouette at r 0.615) so the bright day sky never shows between the core and the white-hot edge; the spec's soft inner edge (0.68-0.72) is drawn as white fading into that black.

name: te5_galaxy_floor
purpose: Dark galaxy pool on the dais base (D2, 29.6 studs), the day-readable dark stage with white arms
notes: Barred 2-arm spiral, arms wind COUNTER-clockwise outward (image +y up): a CLOCKWISE spin of the image makes them trail (spec rate -6 deg/s; verify the Top-face orientation in the preview). Opaque to r 0.86. Mean L 0.218.

name: te5_galaxy_arms
purpose: Floating arm layer above the pool for parallax (D3, 21 studs)
notes: Same winding as the floor, turned 90 deg, pitch 13. Arms are opaque white along their cores with wispy wings and a black lane on the concave (= leading for a counter-clockwise spin) edge. The spec spins D3 at +9 deg/s against D2's -6: counter-rotating layers (strong parallax); its arms then lead rather than trail.

name: te5_galaxy_core
purpose: Bright core layer under the feet (D4, 12 studs)
notes: White core + 4 tightly wound (10 deg) arms with black lanes, same winding as the floor; each arm has its own length (0.68-0.80) and strength so it reads as a vortex, not rings.

name: te5_engraving
purpose: The stage: an engraved clock ring on the ground round the dais (D5, 56 studs; review round 3, was 40)
notes: r 1 = 28 studs. From just outside the dais rim (r 0.585) to r 0.99: a fine guilloche tick band (r 0.64-0.68), Roman numerals 3 studs tall at r 0.80 with half-hour four-point stars, and an INKED minute track (a solid ink band r 0.925-0.975, alpha 1) with white ticks and lume batons every five minutes. White 240 strokes with a 2 px ink (20) outline at alpha 0.95: nothing semi-transparent. Day Brightness 1.0 (the ink carries the day), night 2.0.

name: te5_halo
purpose: Rim-only halo: moon halo billboard (15 studs), night bezel corona (C10, 44 studs) and the void's horizon glow particles (11.2 studs); its ring peaks at r 0.73, and the module scales the three by RIM_R while the pass-2 'rim' texture stands in
notes: White; alpha 0 below r 0.66, 0.95 at 0.74, 0.35 at 0.82, 0.10 at 0.90, 0 at 1.0 (monotone cubic, dithered). Tint with ImageColor3 (236,240,248).

name: te5_stream
purpose: Palm stream beams B1 (silver) and B3 (ink, via Beam Color)
notes: Beam texture: image x runs ALONG the beam (seamless every 256 px, TextureMode Wrap), y across. White core with 6 waving filaments, ink edges. Color WHITE = silver stream with ink edges; Color (18,18,24) = all-ink stream.

name: te5_moon
purpose: Photographic full-moon face for the moon's camera-facing sprite (review round 1, AD4; 9-stud BillboardGui)
notes: North up, Earth-facing side: maria at grey 95-145 where the real ones are, highlands 212-240, ~60 craters with lit upper-left rims and shadowed floors, rayed Tycho/Copernicus/Kepler/Aristarchus, faint limb darkening. Hard alpha edge at r 0.985 (1.6 % ramp), no ring, no glow. With it uploaded the module swaps the white ball + craters + halo for a 6-stud grey core 4.4 studs behind this sprite; until then (fallback) it keeps the geometry moon.

name: te5_star_window
purpose: Deep-space window on the clock's solid movement plate behind the skeleton dial (review round 1, AD1)
notes: Opaque near-black field (alpha 1 to r 0.985), faint grey Milky-Way band at 32 deg with dust lanes, ~2600 single-pixel stars and ~70 soft brighter ones (5 with tiny spikes). Turns with the centre wheel (+6 deg/s). Until uploaded it falls back to the pass-4 galaxy (galaxy4), drawn dimmer.
